cases.purpose: Change global settings between reads in the same decoder process, including both bounds.
cases.script:
unset BASHESCDELAY BASHKGETCH_ESCDELAY
for r in kgetch wgetch; do
 if [[ $r == kgetch ]]; then rd='kgetch read'; else rd='wgetch read 0'; fi
 /usr/bin/python3 tw.py 1b s200 5b41 s100 1b s200 5b41 | {
   escdelay set 5000; $rd
   escdelay set 0; $rd; $rd; $rd; $rd
 } > "$r-keys"
done
cases.oracle: escdelay documented screen/global precedence and 0..5000 bounds; kgetch retains its legacy environment override.
cases.comparison: exact key records from timed pipe feeds with wide timing margins

cases.purpose: Screen state and environment override global values, including a 63-character name and invalid screen environment fallback.
cases.script:
unset BASHESCDELAY BASHKGETCH_ESCDELAY
name=aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
escdelay set 0
export BASHESCDELAY=0
escdelay set --screen "$name" 1000
/usr/bin/python3 tw.py 1b s200 5b41 | { wgetch open 0 "$name" > h; read -r h < h; wgetch read "$h"; wgetch read "$h"; } > state
export BASHESCDELAY_SCREEN_aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa=0
/usr/bin/python3 tw.py 1b s200 5b41 | { wgetch open 0 "$name" > h; read -r h < h; wgetch read "$h"; wgetch read "$h"; wgetch read "$h"; wgetch read "$h"; } > env
export BASHESCDELAY_SCREEN_aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa=invalid
/usr/bin/python3 tw.py 1b s200 5b41 | { wgetch open 0 "$name" > h; read -r h < h; wgetch read "$h"; wgetch read "$h"; } > invalid
cases.oracle: escdelay documented screen/global precedence and 0..5000 bounds; kgetch retains its legacy environment override.
cases.comparison: exact key records from timed pipe feeds with wide timing margins

cases.purpose: The kgetch legacy variable remains effective and a nonempty global environment variable takes precedence.
cases.script:
unset BASHESCDELAY
export BASHKGETCH_ESCDELAY=1000
escdelay set 0
/usr/bin/python3 tw.py 1b s200 5b41 | { kgetch read; kgetch read; } > legacy
export BASHESCDELAY=0
/usr/bin/python3 tw.py 1b s200 5b41 | { kgetch read; kgetch read; kgetch read; kgetch read; } > global
cases.oracle: escdelay documented screen/global precedence and 0..5000 bounds; kgetch retains its legacy environment override.
cases.comparison: exact key records from timed pipe feeds with wide timing margins

cases.purpose: The decoders retain their independent environment/default behavior when escdelay is disabled.
cases.script:
enable -n escdelay
export BASHESCDELAY=1000
for r in kgetch wgetch; do
 if [[ $r == kgetch ]]; then rd='kgetch read'; else rd='wgetch read 0'; fi
 /usr/bin/python3 tw.py 1b s200 5b41 | { $rd; $rd; } > "$r-keys"
done
cases.oracle: escdelay documented screen/global precedence and 0..5000 bounds; kgetch retains its legacy environment override.
cases.comparison: exact key records from timed pipe feeds with wide timing margins
